lessons_used: Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +3.1%), but can also severely backfire (-8.9%) or show no clear effect, with positive predictions often being too high.

Copy changes focused on account persistence safety (+3.5%) and launch call-to-actions (+6.7%) were helpful; launch button predictions were too low (+6.7% measured vs +0.5% predicted), while general intro copy showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns and interactive guides carry severe risk, hurting performance far worse than predicted (-10.1%, -19.3%), while others showed no clear effect.
Notifications, hints, waiting screens, and checklist layout changes showed no clear effect across all tested rounds.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Account Protection Copy
candidates.change: Updates the headline and text on the adoption certificate screen to reassure users that their pet and progress are automatically saved to their account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after sign in, and adoption step drops off to 60.9% conversion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your pet choices and progress are automatically saved to your account so you never lose your companion.

guard.reason: Copy update keeps the adoption certificate functionality intact without violating pricing or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step backed by 8 support emails; copy changes regarding account safety consistently succeed.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Reference Card
candidates.change: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a centered layout with clear instructions on how to reveal, hide, and interact with the pet once on the desktop.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and the finish step conversion is only 67.1%.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet to open controls, drag to move across your screen, or click to chat anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro layout and controls reference stays within allowed onboarding modifications.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns carry severe risk of negative conversion impact based on past tests.

candidates.title: Pre-Adoption Companion Selection Flow
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated companion preview screen right before choosing friend styles in the adoption flow.
candidates.why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off in the funnel (60.9% conversion, median 89s), requiring a clearer progression.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion Base Archetype
pick_friend.body: Select the initial starter style for your new pet companion.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_companion_preview']

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Photo Upload
candidates.change: Moves sign-in to take place immediately after photo upload, letting users customize their pet before creating or logging into an account.
candidates.why: Reordering flows delivered past wins (+12.0%) by aligning account creation with user investment in pet creation.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to take place after photo upload is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering flow steps is volatile; past sign_in reorders averaged only +0.5%.

candidates.title: Instant Account Recovery Copy on Sign-In
candidates.change: Updates the sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize that existing pets and progress will be instantly restored upon signing in.
candidates.why: 8 support emails noted pet reset or disappearance issues after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Preserve & Restore Your Pet
sign_in.body: Log in to safely back up your active companion or restore your existing pets instantly.

guard.reason: Copy update on the sign-in screen maintains its core function without introducing dark patterns or pricing text.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence and proven positive historical lift for account persistence copy.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Launch Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated launch confirmation screen before home_intro that verifies desktop display readiness.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported that pets fail to appear on the desktop or the app stutters at final launch.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_pet_launch_confirm']

candidates.title: Photo Upload Guidelines Assistance
candidates.change: Adds explicit photo upload hint text detailing lighting and focus tips for optimal custom pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted custom results.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo
upload_photos.body: Upload a clear image of your pet to generate your unique custom companion.
upload_photos.hint: Use a clear, well-lit photo showing your pet facing forward for best rendering accuracy.

guard.reason: Adding photo upload guidelines assistance enhances clarity without breaking any onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 39.1% of users, but hints historically yield only minor improvements (+1.8%).

candidates.title: Story-To-Path Direct Transition Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a stage layout that directly continues the story intro.
candidates.why: choose_path sees a 21.7% drop-off right at the start of onboarding (78.3% conversion).

choose_path.headline: Embark on Your Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Select how you would like to start creating your companion experience today.

guard.reason: Redesigning the choose_path layout and copy maintains the step's core purpose while staying within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns carry severe risk and lack strong support email evidence.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Pet Generation Safety Info
candidates.change: Enables progress indicator and reassuring body text on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting step (home target) has high latency (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing drop-offs if users think the app stalled.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Companion to Life
waiting.body: Your pet is being crafted. Please keep this window open while generation completes.

guard.reason: Enabling progress indicator and safety text on the waiting screen preserves its function and adheres to fair design.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high latency waiting step; past wait_info tests yielded +2.0%.

candidates.title: Sign-In Provider Reassurance Banner
candidates.change: Switches sign-in screen to a split layout highlighting safe cloud saving alongside authentication choices.
candidates.why: 2 support emails reported sign-in stalls, while 8 reported account sync issues after re-login.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Companion Account
sign_in.body: Sign in to securely link your pet companion data and maintain persistence across restarts.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in to a split layout with cloud saving reassurance maintains authentication job and onboarding compliance.

candidates.score_note: Layout changes showed negative or no clear effect across previous rounds.

decisions.title: Waiting Screen Pet Generation Safety Info

lessons_next: Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +4.5%, +3.1%), but carries severe downside risk (-8.9%) or no clear effect, with positive predictions often being too optimistic.
Targeted copy changes focused on account persistence safety (+3.5%) and launch call-to-actions (+6.7%) were helpful, with launch CTA predictions being too low (+6.7% measured vs +0.5% predicted).
General intro and adoption protection copy changes showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns and interactive guides carry severe risk, frequently causing significant performance drops worse than predicted (-7.0%, -10.1%, -19.3%) or showing no clear effect.
Notifications, hints, waiting screen progress indicators, and checklist layout adjustments showed no clear effect across all tested rounds.
